verified: The Financial Times reported, based on unnamed sources, that Verizon is in talks to buy Fidium, a fiber broadband operator owned by Searchlight Capital and BCI, in a deal framed around Verizon's 50-million-premises expansion target.
unconfirmed: The ~$6 billion figure, the stage of the negotiations and whether any agreement will be reached; none of Verizon, Fidium, Searchlight or BCI has publicly confirmed the talks, and no filing, timeline or deal terms have been disclosed.

verified: 《金融时报》报道称，Verizon 正与 Fidium 的股东 Searchlight Capital 和 BCI 就收购事宜进行谈判，并称这笔交易与其 5000 万美国家庭和企业覆盖目标相关。
unconfirmed: 约 60 亿美元的价格、交易能否最终达成、具体条款与时间表，这些均仅来自未具名消息源，Verizon 与 Fidium 双方都未公开确认。

titles.en: Verizon in talks to buy fiber operator Fidium for ~$6B, FT reports
titles.zh: Verizon 据报洽谈以约 60 亿美元收购光纤运营商 Fidium
